nodes.label: SaverBro Recommerce OS Implementation Task Ledger
RC-001 Contain and retire the unavailable provider Repair integration
nodes.rationale: Vendor Modules/Repair source is unavailable in this checkout, so the provider must be prevented from becoming an accidental writable authority or boot dependency; recovering vendor source solely to build SaverBro Repair is explicitly out of scope.

nodes.label: RC-002 Establish the reproducible Ultimate POS baseline
nodes.rationale: Certified on the deployment-matching platform because the earlier PHP 8.4 cloud-container run was explicitly not platform certification for 8.2; the route:cache logout-name collision was deferred rather than patched because stock POS code is out of RC-002 scope and the fix requires choosing which route keeps the name.

nodes.rationale: The catalogue is read from the module config file rather than config() so a test that narrows the permission list cannot shrink what the structural guard checks; DataController is the single exemption because it only renders role-editor labels.

nodes.source_location: Status implemented locally; customer search repaired 2026-08-30
nodes.rationale: The intake customer select seeded only the first 200 contacts and filtered client-side, so a business with more customers could not find anyone after the 200th; GET /recommerce/repair/customers already searched the whole book but had no caller and no test coverage.

nodes.label: RC-033 Implement quote versions and approval evidence
nodes.rationale: Quote endpoints store/send/decide have no view caller in the module, so the documented diagnose to quote to approval to work flow cannot be performed in the application; not filled because a quote form requires product decisions the pass was not authorized to invent.

nodes.label: RC-034 Bill customer repair parts/services through POS
RC-035 Complete customer QC, payment policy, and collection
nodes.rationale: The Repeat visit button rendered only inside the READY-gated collection block, carried a disabled attribute that was always true there, and posted an empty command_uuid the submit handler strips, so it was unreachable and would have failed three ways.

nodes.label: RC-036 Add generic tracked-transfer core integration
nodes.rationale: Closes the transfer status hook gap without embedding Recommerce rules in core: the seam must stay generic so a disabled module leaves existing transfer behavior unchanged.

nodes.label: RC-037 Build tracked transfer manifests and receiving exceptions
RC-038 Implement trade-in offer and ownership acquisition
nodes.rationale: Uses a one-unit native UltimatePOS purchase seam and deterministic valuation rules rather than store credit, ML, scraping, or catalogue auto-creation; known limitation is that reversal has no route, controller action, or UI.

nodes.label: RC-039 Add warranty coverage and claim jobs
nodes.rationale: The claim service and POST warranty/claim route shipped with no caller, making the feature unreachable; a latent defect was that WarrantyClaim cast no datetime columns so a re-read claim would fatal on format(), hidden because in-memory models held Carbon.

nodes.label: RC-040 Build reviewed legacy identity/backfill tooling

nodes.rationale: The adapter is deliberately evidence-limited because the checkout has no Modules/Repair source or legacy Repair tables, so it archives only scoped POS transactions rows and records that limitation rather than inventing status, attachment, technician, quote, parts, or warranty history.

nodes.source_location: Demo estate can walk the repair flow
nodes.rationale: Only customer repairs are seeded because a customer-owned device carries stock_participation NONE, so nothing moves core stock or the tracked reconciliation counts the staging smoke verifies; a seeder is a data fixture, not an actor, so it must not hold the cohort/permission gate RepairJobIntakeService enforces.

nodes.label: RepairJobIntakeService
RepairJobStateMachine
cpanel-staging-poll.sh server-local Cron deployment
nodes.rationale: Chosen instead of weakening or bypassing the cPanel UAPI anti-bot boundary, which returns a JavaScript browser challenge that GitHub Actions cannot complete; the script refuses non-fast-forward history and uses a lock directory to prevent overlapping deployments.

nodes.label: route:cache logout name collision blocker
nodes.rationale: Pre-existing stock Ultimate POS: routes/web.php registers Auth::routes() POST /logout named logout and a second GET /logout also named logout, so route:cache and optimize fail; harmless on the current cPanel deployment which never caches routes, but blocks production route-cache optimisation before RC-045.

nodes.label: Endpoint shipped without a UI caller defect class
nodes.rationale: Recurring class where a service plus route ships with no view referencing it, so the documented workflow is unreachable through the application; observed for RC-032 customer search, RC-033 quote store/send/decide, RC-035 repeat visit, and RC-039 warranty claim.

nodes.label: Render views in tests rather than assert source strings
nodes.source_location: Blade compilation guarded across the module
nodes.rationale: Source-string assertions cannot catch a template that throws when it runs; rendering exposed uncompiled Blade directives written after a word character, an always-null assignee accessor, and empty browser tab titles that every earlier pass missed.

nodes.label: Transition error message disclosure decision
nodes.source_location: Transition errors discard the guidance the domain produced
nodes.rationale: RepairJobController::transition replaces precise domain guidance with a generic rejection, so a stale-lock user retries an unwinnable form; left unchanged because the module holds two conventions (intake returns getMessage verbatim, DiagnosticController is generic) and picking one is a disclosure decision, not a bug fix.
